findings.text: assert plant.n_coil == len(machine.coil_names) compares the plant's coil_names -- a copy of the machine.coil_names the test itself passed in at line 169 -- against that same input, so the two sides move together and the assertion cannot fail on the regression it appears to guard; the n_section assertion at line 178 has the same shape.

the zero-rebuild spy patches nova.circuit.conductor.subdivide_passive_thickness, but nova/circuit/passive.py binds that name at import (line 61), so a rebuild introduced inside load_sectioned_machine would call passive's own binding and leave the asserted calls list empty.

conductor_geometry's first returned element changed meaning from the unsectioned source conductors to the refined conductors (machine.conductors) while keeping its position and the caller's name, so a consumer other than the one caller that ignores it would silently receive the refined set.
